args: for name in COCONET_LOCAL_DAG_HOME COCONET_CURSOR_COMMAND CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR XDG_CONFIG_HOME XDG_DATA_HOME COCONET_CA_FILE CURSOR_API_KEY CURSOR_API_ENDPOINT; do eval "value=\${$name-}"; if [ "$value" = "\${env:$name}" ]; then unset "$name"; fi; done; data_root="$XDG_DATA_HOME"; if [ -z "$data_root" ]; then data_root="$HOME/.local/share"; fi; runtime="$data_root/coconet/current/bin/coconet"; if [ ! -x "$runtime" ] && command -v coconet >/dev/null 2>&1; then runtime="$(command -v coconet)"; fi; exec "$runtime" mcp --agent cursor
